About this product

The ZK-MK-V1 is a standalone access control terminal that uses fingerprint recognition for secure authentication. It provides fast and reliable user verification, making it suitable for managing access to buildings and restricted areas. The terminal supports various communication interfaces for integration with existing security systems. It is compatible with a range of accessories including electric locks, door sensors, exit buttons, and standard 12V DC power supplies. It also supports both ID tags and thin ID cards for multiple authentication methods.
